products.name: Ahh Moments | Cherry Berry Shot | Sleepy | 1:1
products.description: Ahh Moments Cherry Berry Shot Sleepy is a 1:1 THC:CBN indica tincture crafted to help you unwind and drift into restful slumber. This 20mg shot delivers a balanced blend of THC and CBN in a delicious cherry berry flavor profile that makes bedtime something to look forward to. The indica classification promotes deep relaxation and sleepy effects, ideal for those seeking relief from restlessness or simply wanting to enhance their nighttime routine. Each shot is perfectly portioned for convenient, fast-acting delivery, allowing you to find your sweet spot without the guesswork. The tart-sweet cherry and berry notes create a pleasant tasting experience that masks any herbal undertones. Whether you're dealing with occasional sleeplessness or just want to elevate your evening wind-down ritual, this tincture offers a discreet, easy-to-use solution that fits seamlessly into your lifestyle. Simply take your shot and let the calming effects wash over you as you drift into peaceful, restorative rest.

products.name: Ahh Moments | Strawberry Cream Party Rosin | Chocolate
products.description: Indulge in Ahh Moments Strawberry Cream Party Rosin Chocolate, a 100mg sativa edible that blends decadent chocolate with luscious strawberry cream flavors. Crafted with premium rosin, this delicious treat delivers an uplifting, energetic experience perfect for social gatherings or creative pursuits. Each bite combines rich, creamy sweetness with the smooth essence of ripe strawberries, creating a party-ready confection that tastes as good as it feels. The sativa classification provides a euphoric, focused boost that keeps you happy and engaged. Whether you're celebrating with friends or treating yourself, this rosin-infused chocolate offers a flavorful escape with elevated effects. Experience the difference of quality rosin extraction in every creamy, strawberry-kissed square.

image.alt: Ahh Moments | Strawberry Cream Party Rosin | Chocolate

products.name: Ahh Moments | Blueberry Vanilla Dream RSO | Chocolate
products.description: Ahh Moments presents Blueberry Vanilla Dream RSO Chocolate, a delicious 100mg indica-infused edible crafted for ultimate relaxation. This decadent chocolate combines the rich sweetness of blueberry and smooth vanilla cream with full-spectrum RSO (Rick Simpson Oil) to deliver powerful, long-lasting effects. Each bite offers a luxurious flavor experience while promoting deep relaxation, relief, and restful sleep—perfect for unwinding after a long day or easing into a peaceful evening. The indica classification ensures calming, body-focused benefits that melt away tension and stress. Whether you're seeking relief from discomfort or simply craving a tranquil escape, this gourmet chocolate treat delivers both exceptional taste and therapeutic effects in one indulgent package.

image.alt: Ahh Moments | Blueberry Vanilla Dream RSO | Chocolate

products.name: Ahh Moments | Atlantic Bliss RSO | Chocolate
products.description: Ahh Moments Atlantic Bliss RSO Chocolate delivers 100mg of hybrid cannabis in a delicious chocolate edible that balances the best of both worlds. This RSO-infused treat combines rich, velvety chocolate flavor with the full-spectrum benefits of Rick Simpson Oil, offering a potent and well-rounded experience. As a hybrid, Atlantic Bliss provides balanced effects that may leave you feeling relaxed yet uplifted, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or enhancing creative moments. The smooth chocolate coating masks any cannabis taste while delivering precise, reliable dosing. Whether you're seeking relief, relaxation, or simply a euphoric escape, this 100mg chocolate bar offers a convenient and discreet way to enjoy cannabis. Perfect for experienced users who appreciate the therapeutic potential of RSO combined with the indulgent pleasure of premium chocolate.

image.alt: Ahh Moments | Atlantic Bliss RSO | Chocolate

Whether you're tackling creative projects or enjoying social gatherings, Raspberry Rosin Revive provides the perfect blend of taste and effect to help you find your ahh moment.
